why: owner 25 Nov: full review, then release the new version

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.9-beta for WoW Forever 1.60.1.71091

Translations
- 152 more WoW Forever quests get a Persian title (Riverglades, Krol'dok, the Drowned City, Sunnyglade, Rog'mar, Zephras Isle...). Their texts exist only in the game: play them with the harvest on and they arrive in the next update.
- Alerts: 'Objective Complete.', 'Resisted' and '... slain: 3/8' in Persian.

Fixes
- Item objectives ('0/1 Fang of Bhag'thera', '0/4 Miners' Union Card') stay English by design until the item bank arrives: they are no longer listed as missing on the status page, and an item named after an NPC is never treated as that NPC (only 'slain' lines use NPC names).
- The WoW Forever tracker's count-first lines ('0/8 Young Tiger slain') get the Persian kill line.
- Item progress alerts ('Fang of Bhag'thera: 1/1') are no longer listed as missing.
- Status page: NPC talk and books get their own share of the list (150 of 400), so names, alerts and quests are never pushed out. The list stays after closing the game; it starts fresh only with a new addon version or the Clear button.
- Smaller harvest file (2000 texts, 2000 letters each at most).
